source_authority.incident_summary: Phase 3 (commit f41ea931) introduced the Layer 6 anti-instinct allowlist short-circuit at obligation_scanner.py:280, which runs BEFORE the imperative-verb checks at lines 313-356. sc:reflect UC-2 empirically verified that a probe line of the form 'Build stub transport now | temporary stub transport — must be replaced in M2' was silently allowlisted (obligations=0, high=0, undischarged=0) because the substring 'stub transport' triggered _is_allowlisted before the imperative verb 'Build' could prove the line was genuine scaffolding work. The allowlist subtracts from FPs only (Contract #10) — masking a real obligation is a Contract #10 regression.
source_authority.fix_approach: B — extend _is_allowlisted to also probe an imperative-verb-paired-with-SCAFFOLD-term regex; if both an allowlist phrase AND an imperative-verb pair are present in the same line, the imperative verb wins and the line is NOT allowlisted.

expected_contract_10_invariant: MUST FAIL pre-fix (line silently allowlisted, 0 obligations), MUST PASS post-fix (imperative-verb override emits all 3 SCAFFOLD-term obligations: 2x 'stub' + 1x 'temporary')
